name: Traveler - The AI Story
source:
Welcome to Traveler, a unique and immersive gaming experience unlike any other. In this game, you'll embark on a journey through a series of diverse and fantastical worlds, all crafted by advanced artificial intelligence.

As you explore these mysterious and alien landscapes, you'll be treated to stunning graphics and immersive soundscapes, all generated by AI. From dark forests and snowy lands, to bustling cities and vast deserts, no two worlds will be the same.

In addition to the breathtaking visuals, you'll also encounter fully-realized characters and environments, all brought to life with AI-generated text. Whether you're interacting with non-playable characters or simply taking in the sights and sounds of your surroundings, you'll be constantly amazed by the creativity and depth of the AI-generated content.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216270/Traveler__The_AI_Story/?beta=1]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《Traveler》，一段别具一格的沉浸式游戏体验。在这里，你将踏上一段旅程，穿越一系列风格迥异的奇幻世界，而这些世界全部由先进的人工智能构建。

探索这些神秘而陌生的景观时，你将欣赏到令人惊叹的画面和身临其境的声音环境，同样全部由AI生成。从幽暗森林、冰雪大地，到繁华城市、辽阔沙漠，没有两个世界会完全相同。

除了壮丽的视觉景观，你还会遇到鲜活的角色与细致的环境，由AI生成的文本赋予它们生命。无论是与非玩家角色互动，还是单纯感受周围的声色，你都会不断惊叹于AI生成内容的创意与深度。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216270/Traveler__The_AI_Story/?beta=1]Steam[/url]]
